_comment: Non-computed manuscript fields. Every value marked PENDING must be replaced before submission; render_manuscript.py exits non-zero while any remain.
CORRESPONDING_EMAIL: PENDING - institutional or durable address; the previous draft used a placeholder gmail address
ORCID: PENDING - register at https://orcid.org and insert the iD
PREREG_ID: PENDING - OSF Registries or AsPredicted identifier, obtained BEFORE the live run
ZENODO_DOI: PENDING - Zenodo DOI for the versioned archive
CODE_COMMIT: PENDING - git commit SHA archived in the Zenodo deposit
DEVIATIONS_STATEMENT: PENDING - either 'Section 12 of the preregistration; none were recorded' or a summary of recorded deviations
ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS: PENDING - or state 'The author received no specific funding for this work.'
COMPETING_INTERESTS_EXTRA: PENDING - confirm whether employer publication clearance is required and has been obtained, and state it if so
